title: SQLi quick validation (sqlmap, scoped)
description: Confirm and safely enumerate injection points found manually.
detail: Use after a manual signal (error/boolean/time). Keep scope tight. 1) sqlmap -u <url> -p <param> --batch --level 1 --risk 1 first; escalate only if needed and safe. 2) Limit to enumeration needed for proof (current db/user) unless exploitation/impact is explicitly authorized. 3) Never dump unnecessary PII; capture minimal evidence. Record as vuln fact with repro.
